description: Sub-case 1 (cooking): urgency_score=0.5 in cooking mode (alert threshold 'low' = 0.3). Alert fires at gate 1b — ALERT_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED — even before EOU is confirmed. Sub-case 2 (normal): same urgency_score=0.5 in normal mode (alert threshold 'medium' = 0.6). 0.5 < 0.6 so gate 1b passes; eou_probability=0.3 <= 0.5 so gate 3 returns silence (NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT). Positive/negative discriminator pair for alert_threshold mode-sensitivity.

fixture_conventions.alert_threshold_note: cooking mode maps to 'low' in AlertThresholdConfig; _LEVEL_TO_FLOAT_THRESHOLD['low'] = 0.3. normal mode maps to 'medium' = 0.6.
fixture_conventions.sub_cases: cooking (alert fires at urgency_score=0.5 > 0.3) and normal (alert does NOT fire at urgency_score=0.5 < 0.6; silenced at EOU gate instead).
fixture_conventions.urgency_score: 0.5 for both sub-cases — the discriminating variable is current_task_mode.
fixture_conventions.social_mode: direct — not in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES; gate 1 does not block.
fixture_conventions.eou_probability: 0.3 (sub-case 2 only) — <= 0.5 threshold, so gate 3 returns silence.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
